id.instruksi: Budi mau bermain di taman. Dengarkan apa yang akan ia lakukan, lalu sentuh bagian tubuh yang akan paling bekerja.
id.t-1: Budi melompat. Otot pada bagian mana yang mendorong tubuhnya ke atas?
id.t-2: Budi berlari. Otot pada bagian mana yang menggerakkan langkah kakinya?
id.t-3: Budi menaiki tangga. Otot pada bagian mana yang mengangkat tubuhnya ke anak tangga berikutnya?
id.t-4: Budi menarik napas. Organ mana yang terisi udara di dalam dadanya?
id.t-5: Budi menghirup udara segar. Organ mana yang mengambil oksigen dari udara itu?
id.t-6: Budi meniup kincir. Udara dikeluarkan dari organ mana di dalam dadanya?
id.t-7: Budi mendorong ayunan dengan tangan. Otot pada bagian mana yang meluruskan sikunya?
id.t-8: Budi bergelantungan sambil menekuk siku. Otot pada bagian mana yang menekuk sikunya?
id.t-9: Budi mengangkat ember dengan menekuk siku. Otot pada bagian mana yang menekuk sikunya?
id.t-10: Budi menghitung bunga. Organ mana yang membantunya berpikir dan menghitung?
id.t-11: Budi mengingat jalan pulang. Organ mana yang membantunya menyimpan dan mengingat informasi?

en.judul: How the Body Works at the Park
en.instruksi: Budi wants to play in the park. Listen to what he will do, then touch the body part that will work the most.
en.t-1: Budi jumps. Which body part has the muscles that push his body upward?
en.t-2: Budi runs. Which body part has the muscles that move his legs?
en.t-3: Budi climbs the steps. Which body part has the muscles that lift him to the next step?
en.t-4: Budi breathes in. Which organs fill with air inside his chest?
en.t-5: Budi breathes in fresh air. Which organs take oxygen from that air?
en.t-6: Budi blows a pinwheel. Which organs inside his chest release the air?
en.t-7: Budi pushes a swing with his hands. Which body part has the muscles that straighten his elbows?
en.t-8: Budi hangs from a bar with bent elbows. Which body part has the muscles that bend his elbows?
en.t-9: Budi lifts a bucket by bending his elbows. Which body part has the muscles that bend his elbows?
en.t-10: Budi counts flowers. Which organ helps him think and count?
en.t-11: Budi remembers the way home. Which organ helps him store and remember information?
